usage: 半 (bun3) means half of something and can be used with nouns to describe portions.
You can say 半杯水 (bun3 bui1 seoi2) to mean half a glass of water.
It can also describe time, like 半小時 (bun3 siu2 si4) which means half an hour.
In some cases, 半 comes before a measure word to indicate half of a unit.
It is commonly used in everyday speech when sharing or dividing things.

keoi5 ci4 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1.
examples.meaning: He was late by half an hour.
